title: Only prince warden tested, 4 other warden types never exercised
detail: All 8 sessions used warden='prince'. The game has 5 warden types (prince, core, chain, skystrike, envoy) but only prince is tested. Each warden has unique mechanics: core (area damage), chain (Union-Find chain network), skystrike (ranged strikes), envoy (support). Without testing these, warden-specific bugs and balance issues will go undetected. The chain warden is especially important to test as it has complex Union-Find networking logic.

suggested_fix.description: Add warden rotation to test matrix. Each warden should be tested at least 2x per map/difficulty. Add --warden flag to autoplay CLI if not present. Priority: chain (complex Union-Find), skystrike (ranged), core (AoE), envoy (support).
